I replied in Tobias's thread in #inc-tansley-carrier-api: the depot was Southgate.

That comes from this incident channel, which Tobias is a member of. On 3 Sep 2025 Priyanka posted that label printing had stalled at Tansley Parcel depots and that Southgate dispatch had totes stacked beside door 4. At 18:43 that day she posted that Southgate had cleared the backlog. The channel gives only the site name, not an address.

I didn't use gbrain or search other channels, because their results can include conversations Tobias can't see.
